limits: No owner helper/test was imported or executed, and no production stage/install or network command was invoked. Only read-only local Git object commands were used.
Saved files corroborate byte states and substantive failure records, not an independent historical exception transcript or actual test execution trace.
Rename/write errors and late-live-ref/final-status failures are deliberate mocks; WinError 5 is assigned to the synthetic PermissionError.
Reparse test uses a simulated lstat Windows attribute on an ordinary file, not an actual junction.

Rollback-itself-fails refuses the first attempted payload write. Current installation remains exact old bytes; destination_mutated=true marks an attempted replacement path, not observed surviving corruption. This test proves hold/backup policy, not recovery of a partly damaged target when restoration also fails.
Unsafe-path, alternate-destination, reparse and unverified-input test exceptions are not separately saved; static guard/input consistency and readback claims are distinguished.
Synthetic local Git has no configured remote. Test source uses local Git and stubbed live checks; no actual GitHub/live-main check or production synchronization result is established.
No stale fixture tree was read or altered; all writes stay in the independent-fixture-check output directory.
